    "statement": "For integers $n$ and $k$ with $1\le k\le n-1$, let $F_k(K_n)$ be the $k$-token graph of the complete graph $K_n$, also known as the Johnson graph. The tree decomposition of this graph constructed in the paper is a candidate decomposition. **Johnson graph pathwidth conjecture.** The decomposition is optimal, and

$$
\operatorname{pw}(F_k(K_n))=\operatorname{tw}(F_k(K_n)).
$$
